8: ## 1. 目标与固定结论
9: 
10: 目标是在 BK7258 上运行一个 NuttX SMP 实例：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 共同执行同一个
11: OpenVela `nuttx.bin`，目标 AP 核频率为 480 MHz。物理 CPU0 继续运行 Armino CP，
12: 并继续拥有全芯片电源、DPLL、核心/总线时钟、电压、PSRAM PHY、硬件 WDT 和
13: CPU1 电源生命周期。
14: 
15: 正式架构固定为：
16: 
17: | 物理核 | NuttX 编号 | 角色 | 目标频率 |
18: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
19: | CPU0 | 不可见 | Armino CP，电源/频率执行者 | 240 MHz（480 MHz档位下） |
20: | CPU1 | 0 | OpenVela AP primary、系统 tick、CP transport owner | 480 MHz |
21: | CPU2 | 1 | OpenVela AP secondary、通用 SMP 调度 | 480 MHz |
22: 
23: BK7258 的 `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 不是三核都运行 480 MHz。原厂档位意图是：
24: 
25: ```text
26: core source: 480 MHz
27: CPU0:       240 MHz
28: CPU1:       480 MHz
29: CPU2:       480 MHz
30: bus:        240 MHz
31: ```
32: 
33: 当前 HAL 已明确写入 480 MHz source、CPU0 `/2` 和 CPU1/CPU2 `/1`，但
34: `sys_hal_core_bus_clock_ctrl()` 虽接收 `ckdiv_bus`，实际只改 `CLK_DIV_REG0[3:0]`
35: 的 core divider，没有写 bit 6 的 bus divider。因此 CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 目标值有源码
36: 依据，bus 240 MHz 仍是必须通过寄存器和实测确认的目标，不能只凭档位注释验收。
37: 
38: 依据为：
39: 
40: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:346-353`
41: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:571-658`
42: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:2218-2283`

44: 必须同时接受以下结论：
45: 
46: 1. 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。CPU2 reset/vector、核 ID、每核中断栈、IPI、
47:    SMP atomic 和驱动并发都必须实现。
48: 2. 不能只把 AP `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 改为 480 MHz。CP 是共享核心时钟的
49:    唯一执行者，必须在释放 CPU1 reset 前建立 480 MHz vote，并在 AP 停止后释放。
50: 3. 首版 480 MHz SMP 运行期间禁止 runtime DVFS。CPU1/CPU2 的核心时钟变化会直接
51:    改变 SysTick；没有 pre-change/post-change 协议和时间补偿时，运行中改频会破坏
52:    timeout、sleep、scheduler tick 和 heartbeat。
53: 4. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y` 是必需配置，不是可选优化。当前 32 位配置已经造成
54:    可重复的长期静置重启。
55: 5. CPU2 不需要独立镜像或分区。CPU1/CPU2 共享 `app1.bin`、地址空间和调度器；
56:    CPU2 只需要同一镜像内的 secondary boot vector。
57: 6. CPU2 启动失败时不得静默降级为单核。`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 下必须 fail-stop，
58:    否则 NuttX per-CPU 和调度器状态不完整。
59: 7. 首版只支持普通 idle WFI。CP coordinated low-voltage、CPU1/CPU2 掉电、CPU2
60:    hotplug 和 runtime DVFS 必须在独立阶段完成，不得和首次 SMP bring-up 混合。

103: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
104: 
105: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
106: 
107: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
108: 
109: ```c
110: for (;;)
111:   {
112:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
113:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
114:   }
115: ```
116: 
117: 来源：
118: 
119: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
120: 
121: 当前最终配置同时满足：
122: 
123: ```text
124: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
125: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
126: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
127: ```
128: 
129: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
130: 
131: ```c
132: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
133: {
134:   ...
135:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
140: 
141: ```c
142: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
143: ```
144: 
145: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
146: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
147: 
148: ```text
149: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
150: ```
151: 
152: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
153: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
154: 
155: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
156: 
157: ```text
158: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
159: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
160: ```
161: 
162: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
163: 
164: 必需修复：
165: 
166: ```text
167: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
168: ```
169: 
170: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
171: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。
172: 
173: ### 3.2 CP 60 MHz 与 AP 120 MHz 配置不一致
174: 
175: 当前 AP SysTick 使用：
176: 
177: ```c
178: systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1);
179: ```
180: 
181: AP 配置是 120 MHz，但 CP 配置和初始化代码会执行：
182: 
183: ```text
184: CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=y
185: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)
186: ```
187: 
188: 而 60 MHz 档位同时影响 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 和 bus。结果是 AP 以 120 MHz 计算的
189: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。
190: 
191: 这也精确解释了重启为何发生在约 2 小时 23 分，而不是约 1 小时 11 分：
192: 
193: ```text
194: 4,294.967296 s * (120 / 60) = 8,589.934592 s
195: ```
196: 
197: 实板在约 `8,594.5 s` assert，差值位于最后一帧 heartbeat 到 6 秒 timeout 的窗口。
198: 
199: ### 3.3 CP heartbeat 配置符号错误
200: 
201: CP heartbeat 代码检查 `CONFIG_WDT_EN`，当前生成配置实际使用 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 和
202: `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000`。所以最终固件走的是 `2000 * 3 = 6000 ms` fallback。
203: 
204: 应将 CP 条件改为实际 watchdog 配置符号，并明确 heartbeat timeout 策略。但即使改成
205: 8 秒，也不能替代 AP 时间和频率修复。

207: ## 4. 电源、频率与核生命周期所有权

209: ### 4.1 所有权表
210: 
211: | 资源 | 唯一执行者 | OpenVela AP 职责 |
212: | --- | --- | --- |
213: | DPLL/core source/core divider/bus divider | CPU0/CP PM | 只声明固定 480 MHz 契约并校验结果；bus divider 未验证前不得发布 ready |
214: | VDDD/VDDDIG 高压档 | CPU0/CP PM | 不直接写 analog/PMU 电压寄存器 |
215: | CPU1 power/reset/boot offset | CPU0/CP | 发送 ready/recovery，不能直接关闭自身 |
216: | CPU2 power domain | CPU0/CP | 请求域保持 ON；不得直接改 `CPU2_PWR_DW/HALT` 绕过 CP accounting |
217: | CPU2 reset/boot offset | CPU1/AP primary | `up_cpu_start(1)` 写 secondary vector 并释放 reset |
218: | CPU2 scheduler/idle/IPI | OpenVela SMP | 完整管理 |
219: | PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、容量检测 | CPU0/CP | 通过 PWC vote；只管理 AP allocator |
220: | SysTick 和 NuttX monotonic time | CPU1/OpenVela | 固定频率下维护；低压阶段用 AON 时间补偿 |
221: | WDT 和 heartbeat assert | CPU0/CP | AP 持续发送 heartbeat，处理 transport 错误 |

223: 这里的 ID 属于两个不同命名空间：`PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 是共享 frequency vote 表的 owner
224: slot，不是 CPU1 power-domain ID，也不存在 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU2` frequency slot。CPU1/CPU2
225: 电源必须分别使用 `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`、`PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2`。当前 power
226: enum 中 CPU1、APP、CPU2 的值依次为17、18、19；禁止根据公共头文件中的过时数字注释
227: 硬编码 ID。

229: ### 4.2 480 MHz 启动时序
230: 
231: CP 必须在释放 CPU1 reset 之前建立 480 MHz，不能等 AP 启动后再通过 PWC 改频：
232: 
233: ```text
234: CP OpenVela AP boot transaction
235:   -> sole owner写PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M
236:   -> 验证owner slot、PM cache和实际clock/voltage寄存器
237:   -> 用语义化helper确认CPU2处于reset-hold
238:   -> 获取OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold并确认domain ON
239:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
240:   -> 按34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical规则计算CPU1 boot offset
241:   -> 用已验证的语义化helper release CPU1 reset
242:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
243:   -> nx_start()内部调用nx_smp_start()/up_cpu_start(1)
244:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并用语义化helper release reset
245:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
246:   -> PSRAM PWC真实成功后发布AP power-up/heartbeat/PWC ready
247: ```
248: 
249: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
250: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：
251: 
252: - `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 只有一个覆盖式 byte slot，不是引用计数。480 MHz vote 必须只有
253:   一个生命周期 owner；建议由新的 OpenVela boot transaction 在任何 CPU1/CPU2 power-on
254:   前写入。`user_app_main()` 只请求事务启动，`pm_module_bootup_cpu1()` 不得重复投同一 slot。
255: - `PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT=60M` 可保留。PM 取所有 slot 最大值，AP online 时480M胜出；AP
256:   vote释放后回到60M是当前CP配置的正常策略。只有明确要求AP关闭后CP回到120M时，才
257:   条件跳过最终60M写入，该选择不是建立480M契约的必要条件。
258: - `bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get()` 只是软件 cache。上电前必须同时校验
259:   `bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1)`、current max、core source、core
260:   divider、bus divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed和VDDDIG；软件状态与寄存器不一致即失败。
261: - 新增 OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold API。它只做独立 owner accounting、控制
262:   `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2` 并等待power readback；不得调用 `start_cpu2_core()`、写
263:   CPU2 offset或release reset。现有boot-vote API会同时启动CPU2，不适用于单镜像NuttX。
264: - CPU1 boot继续复用 `get_partition_addr(1)` 的34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical
265:   转换及SoC address处理，最终寄存器写入转换后地址的 `offset >> 8`，不得写raw partition
266:   start。
267: - 裸 `CPU1/2_SW_RST=0/1` 的HAL注释与原厂start/stop helper语义矛盾。实施时必须提供
268:   `cpu_hold_reset()`/`cpu_release_reset()`，通过run-status和实板启动试验确定极性并修正
269:   注释；方案和日志不能把未经验证的裸值直接命名为assert/release。
270: - `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig`：增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` bool 选项，
271:   默认关闭；只在 `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` 中由 OpenVela 构建启用。
272: 
273: 所有 CP 源码修改必须同时在比赛仓 `external/bk_avdk_smp/` 权威副本中保留，并更新
274: `external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md` 的覆盖文件表和同步命令，不能只修改
275: `bk_avdk_smp` 构建树。同步方法见该 README 第 2 节。

321: 同时更新并拒绝未知版本。AP释放自己的owner不能关闭仍被CP owner使用的PHY。
322: 
323: ### 4.3 运行期频率规则
324: 
325: 首版运行期规则只有一条：AP online 时 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 始终 vote 480 MHz。
326: 
327: - CP 默认60 MHz vote可以保留；PM取所有module slot的最大值，AP生命周期内唯一的480M
328:   slot会把共享时钟保持在480 MHz。
329: - AP 不发送 `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` 降频。
330: - 其他 CP/AP module 可以投票，但不能把最大值降到 480 MHz以下。
331: - CP 应提供诊断查询，至少输出 current max vote、全部vote owner、core source、core/bus
332:   divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed、VDDD/VDDDIG、CPU1/CPU2 power/reset和PSRAM owner状态。
333: - `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 被 `CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M` 截断时必须判为启动失败，
334:   不能继续用 480 MHz SysTick配置运行。
335: 
336: 建议扩展双方一致的 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` enum，增加只读的 current frequency 与 divider
337: 查询。扩展必须同时更新 AP/CP header 和 source override，不能单边复用已有 enum 数值。
338: 
339: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
340: 
341: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
342: 
343: ```text
344: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
345:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
346:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
347:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
348:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
349:   -> CPU1用语义化helper将CPU2置reset并确认不再执行
350:   -> AP释放自己的PSRAM PWC owner并等待CP ACK
351:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
352:   -> CP确认CPU2 reset，释放power-only hold并确认CPU2 domain OFF
353:   -> CP停止/reset CPU1并确认CPU1 domain OFF
354:   -> CP以PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 slot
355:   -> CP按CPU档位和剩余PSRAM owner重新计算VDDDIG
356: ```
357: 
358: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
359: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2仍在执行共享NuttX状态时，CP不能
360: 直接关闭CPU2 power；CPU1已停止后也不能再依赖CPU1去park CPU2。
361: 
362: 所有失败必须达到相同后置条件，但不能强制走同一callback路径：CPU1/CPU2不执行、只对
363: 本事务已获取的CPU2/CPU1 domain、OpenVela PSRAM owner和480M slot按反序释放。
364: 
365: - 480M/readback失败发生在CPU1 release前：CP直接撤销已获取资源，不等待AP。
366: - CPU1 boot超时：CP强制CPU1/CPU2 reset并关闭domain，不等待AP recovery。
367: - CPU2 online超时：CPU1若仍可信就强制CPU2 reset，不能依赖未online的stop callback。
368: - 只有正常recovery才使用完整AP quiesce、park和ready握手。
369: 
370: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
371: 
372: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
373: 
374: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
375: 
376: - 增加BK7258 `up_idle()`；当前公共ARM `up_idle()`中的WFI被 `#if 0` 禁用，不能把
377:   “空闲任务在运行”误判为已经WFI。chip hook必须清 `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`，执行
378:   `DSB; WFI; ISB`，且不设置coordinated low-voltage ready bit。
379: - CP在每次OpenVela启动和recovery时显式调用
380:   `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` 并检查 `BK_OK`。
381:   state 0表示AP active/not-ready，因此全芯片low-voltage条件不成立。
382: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
383: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
384: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。
385: 
386: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
387: AP 时应显式写exit-sleep，不能依赖BSS初值；PM初始化实际上会把CPU1置为enter-sleep，
388: 而当前清除代码又受已关闭的 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件控制。OpenVela必须
389: 独立执行上述调用，保证未实现低压协议时CP只能进入normal sleep。
390: 
391: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
392: 
393: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
394: 
395: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
396:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
397: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
398: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
399: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
400: 
401: NuttX实现必须复用现有SMP PM框架，而不是另建平行barrier：
402: 
403: 1. 启用 `CONFIG_PM=y`、选定governor、`CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3` 和
404:    `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0`；这里的0是NuttX logical CPU0/物理CPU1，不是CP。
405: 2. BK7258 `up_idle()` 调用 `pm_idle(handler)`；驱动通过 `pm_register()` 注册
406:    `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callback。
407: 3. logical CPU0作为last CPU发起全局transition，禁止新任务迁移、DMA和mailbox
408:    transaction；两核运行per-CPU prepare并保存本核NVIC/SysTick状态。
409: 4. CPU2设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入WFI；CPU1确认CPU2已就绪。
410: 5. CPU1停止SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有sleep vote允许CP进入低压。
411: 6. CP只在两个AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和mailbox idle都满足后切换低压。
412: 7. CP恢复DPLL、经readback验证的480 MHz档位和bus后，通过Mailbox唤醒AP。
413: 8. CPU1读取AON elapsed time，恢复monotonic time和SysTick；再唤醒CPU2。
414: 9. 两核恢复NVIC和驱动callback，`pm_idle()`完成restore并恢复heartbeat。
415: 
416: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖core-clock SysTick。增加BK7258 strong
417: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以AON RTC构建64位单调epoch；当前原厂启用
418: 64-bit AON counter，应使用稳定的low/high重读算法，不需要软件扩展32-bit wrap。必须由
419: CP契约确认32 kHz源是32000还是32768 Hz，并用64位算术换算、校准和验证回卷单调性。
420: 
421: 时间读取本身不是唤醒源。P1必须提供下一NuttX deadline的AON/CP wake：推荐启用
422: `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y`，实现完整的 `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/
423: `up_timer_tick_start()` 或 `up_alarm_cancel()`/`up_alarm_start()` AON compare backend。
424: 若暂时保持periodic语义，则必须编程AON wake不晚于下一1 ms tick，收益有限。恢复时先
425: 确认clock稳定，再重启SysTick；解除PM barrier前必须让logical CPU0至少执行一次timer
426: processing，使低压期间到期的sleep和watchdog立即得到处理。
427: 
428: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。
429: 
430: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
431: 
432: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：
433: 
434: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。
435: - CP/bootloader重新启动 CPU1，CPU1重新启动 CPU2。
436: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。
437: - 不承诺从原 PC/任务现场继续运行。
438: 
439: ## 6. NuttX SMP 芯片层实现
440: 
441: ### 6.1 配置硬门禁
442: 
443: AP defconfig目标配置：
444: 
445: ```text

447: CONFIG_SMP=y
448: CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2
449: CONFIG_SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x3
450: CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=2048
451: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
452: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
453: CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y
454: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
455: CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000

458: 
459: 上述是S0-S4/P0配置。P1另增加：
460: 
461: ```text

463: CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3
464: CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0

466: CONFIG_PM_GOVERNOR_EXPLICIT_RELAX=-1

470: `ARCH_CHIP_BK7258` 增加：
471: 
472: ```kconfig

474: select LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK if SMP
475: ```
476: 
477: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/Kconfig:15-17` 的 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值从
478: `120000000` 改为 `480000000`。`bk7258_timerisr.c:16` 直接引用该宏传递给
479: `systick_initialize()`，无需额外修改 timerisr 源码。
480: 
481: 最终 `.config` 必须确认 `clock_t` 为64位、toolchain atomic没有绕过 BK7258 backend、
482: CPU数为2。禁止只修改生成的 `.config`；必须修改项目 defconfig并执行 distclean。
483: 
484: ### 6.2 文件与构建接入
485: 
486: 建议最小新增：
487: 
488: ```text
489: chips/bk7258/
490:   bk7258_cpustart.c       # secondary vector、reset、online handshake
491:   bk7258_cpuindex.c       # logical CPU ID
492:   bk7258_cpuidlestack.c   # secondary idle stack
493:   bk7258_idle.c           # P0 WFI；P1调用NuttX pm_idle
494:   bk7258_smpcall.c        # raw Mailbox IPI
495:   bk7258_hwspinlock.c     # AP_SPINLOCK software gate
496:   bk7258_atomic.c         # g_atomic_hwspinlock
497: ```
498: 
499: 修改：
500: 
501: ```text
502: Kconfig
503: CMakeLists.txt
504: Make.defs
505: bk7258_start.c
506: bk7258_vectors.c
507: bk7258_irq.c
508: bk7258_timerisr.c
509: bk7258_mbox0.c
510: bk7258_mailbox_channel.c

512: hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
513: board scripts/ld.script
514: board configs/nsh/defconfig
515: ```
516: 
517: Make和CMake必须包含同一组SMP源文件，并仅在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下编译专用对象。
518: 
519: ### 6.3 CPU ID
520: 
521: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
522: 
523: ```text
524: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
525: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
526: ```
527: 
528: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
529: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
530: 
531: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
532: 
533: 分区保持：
534: 
535: ```text
536: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
537: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
538: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
539: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
540: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
541: ```
542: 
543: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
544: 
545: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
546: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
547: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
548: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
549: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
550: 
551: secondary vector：
552: 
553: ```text
554: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
555: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
556: ```
557: 
558: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
559: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
560: 
561: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
562: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
563: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
564: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
565: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
566: MSP。
567: 
568: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
569: 
570: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
571: 
572: ```text
573: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
574:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
575:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
576:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
577:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
578:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
579:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
580:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
581:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
582:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
583: ```
584: 
585: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
586: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
587: 
588: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
589: 
590: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
591: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
592: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
593: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
594: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
595: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started()`、`nx_idle_trampoline()`。
596: 
597: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
598: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
599: 
600: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
601: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
602: 
603: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
604: 
605: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
606: 
607: - AP Flash RO/X。
608: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
609: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
610: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
611: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
612: - peripheral Device/XN。
613: 
614: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
615: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
616: 
617: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
618: 
619: ```text
620: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
621: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
622: ```
623: 
624: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
625: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
626: 
627: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
628: 
629: ### 7.1 物理channel
630: 
631: | channel | owner | FIFO |
632: | ---: | --- | --- |
633: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
634: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
635: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
636: 
637: 沿用原厂消息分类：
638: 
639: ```text
640: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
641: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
642: ```
643: 
644: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
645: logical CPU0负责。
646: 
647: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
648: 
649: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
650: 
651: ```text
652: bk7258_mailbox_init()
653: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
654: bk7258_mailbox_start()
655: ```
656: 
657: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
658: 
659: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
660: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
661:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
662: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
663: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
664: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
665: 
666: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
667: 
668: 实现：
669: 
670: ```c
671: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
672: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
673: ```
674: 
675: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
676: pending后DMB，然后调用：
677: 
678: ```c
679: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
680: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
681: ```
682: 
683: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
684: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
685: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
686: 
687: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
688: 
689: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
690: 
691: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
692: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
693: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
694: 
695: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
696: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁NuttX `atomic_*` 和libc out-of-line atomic helper：
697: 
698: ```text
699: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
700: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> struct hwspinlock_dev_s -> BK7258 software gate
701: ```
702: 
703: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
704: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
705: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
706: 
707: 这不会自动拦截编译器内联 `__atomic_*`、`__sync_*` 或手写exclusive loop。SMP源码禁止
708: 直接使用这些路径，构建时反汇编全部SMP对象，除approved gate外发现LDREX/STREX或
709: LDAXR/STXR循环即失败。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
710: 
711: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
712: 
713: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
714: 
715: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
716: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
717: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
718: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
719: 
720: `kthread_create()` 后立即 `sched_setaffinity(mask=0x1)`；失败则该driver bring-up失败。
721: 
722: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
723: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
724: 
725: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
726: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
727: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
728: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
729: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
730: 
731: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
732: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
733: 
734: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
735: 
736: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
737: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
738: 
739: 必须满足：
740: 
741: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
742: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
743: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
744: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
745: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
746: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
747:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
748: 
749: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
750: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
751: 
752: ## 10. 分阶段实施
753: 
754: ### S0：先修复单核时间和480 MHz契约
755: 
756: 1. AP defconfig 增加 `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，保持单核 `CONFIG_SMP` 关闭。
757: 2. AP `Kconfig` 将 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值改为 `480000000`。
758: 3. CP增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 和单一boot transaction owner；在任何AP power-on
759:    前写 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1=PM_CPU_FRQ_480M`，保留默认60M slot，并显式写CPU1 exit-sleep。
760: 4. 修复DVFS子函数错误传播、bus divider写入/readback和CPU/PSRAM联合VDDDIG下限；把CP
761:    boot PSRAM和OpenVela PWC纳入独立owner accounting并透传真实初始化错误。
762: 5. CP 修正 `mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` 的 watchdog 配置符号从 `CONFIG_WDT_EN` 改为实际
763:    `CONFIG_INT_WDT`，使 timeout 正确反映 `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS`。
764: 6. 增加CP全部frequency owner、source/divider/speed/voltage/power/PSRAM readback诊断。
765: 7. AP heartbeat worker 检查 `bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 返回值，记录 `-EBUSY`、
766:    `-ENOLINK` 和 transport timeout 计数。
767: 
768: 退出条件：20次冷启动、60秒时间校准、3小时静置无heartbeat timeout；PM slot/cache和
769: 实际寄存器一致，CPU0=240 MHz、CPU1=480 MHz、CPU2 speed字段为480 MHz目标，bus经
770: divider readback和外部测量确认为240 MHz，无320M clamp；PSRAM ON/OFF故障注入不会发布
771: 虚假ready或把VDDDIG降到有效owner要求以下。
772: 
773: ### S1：SMP编译与内存骨架
774: 
775: 1. 打开SMP配置，增加CPU ID、每核interrupt stack、`up_get_intstackbase()` 和secondary
776:    idle stack。
777: 2. 增加SPINLOCK MEMORY和atomic backend。
778: 3. 增加secondary vector和链接断言，暂不release CPU2。
779: 4. 增加P0 `up_idle()` 普通WFI；两核MPU表增加AP_SPINLOCK和相同PSRAM属性。
780: 
781: 退出条件：clean build通过；map、vector、stack、gate和heap边界全部正确；反汇编确认
782: exclusive loop只存在于approved gate，P0 idle object确实包含 `DSB/WFI/ISB`。
783: 
784: ### S2：CPU2启动到idle
785: 
786: 1. CP通过OpenVela power-only hold在AP生命周期内保持CPU2 domain ON，并在handoff前
787:    保持经验证的reset状态；CP不调用原厂 `start_cpu2_core()`。
788: 2. AP实现语义化CPU2 reset helper、private arch init、stack切换和release/acquire online
789:    handshake，且不写CPU2 power-domain控制位。
790: 3. CPU2只运行NuttX idle，不路由普通外设。
791: 
792: 退出条件：100次冷启动，CPU2每次500 ms内online；任何失败都fail-stop且有寄存器诊断。
793: 
794: ### S3：IPI与调度
795: 
796: 1. 配置channel 2 FIFO和per-core IRQ79。
797: 2. 实现pending-bit raw IPI、`up_send_smp_sched/call`。
798: 3. 完成双向call、task migration、semaphore/mutex和atomic压力。
799: 
800: 退出条件：两核100%负载1小时，无lost IPI、死锁、counter mismatch和heartbeat timeout。
801: 
802: ### S4：恢复驱动
803: 
804: 1. worker/IRQ固定CPU0。
805: 2. 审计Mailbox、syslog、GPIO/PWM/I2C、PSRAM、Wi-Fi和camera共享状态。
806: 3. 依次恢复console、PWC/heartbeat、PSRAM、GPIO/PWM、Wi-Fi和camera。
807: 
808: 退出条件：单核已有功能全部回归，CPU2压力不影响CP transport和外设owner。
809: 
810: ### P1：低压睡眠
811: 
812: 1. 启用NuttX PM SMP框架、三个domain、logical CPU0 last-CPU和driver callback。
813: 2. 实现AON-backed 64位monotonic time及tickless AON compare/deadline wake backend。
814: 3. 在 `pm_idle(handler)` 内实现双核AON WFI bit和CP sleep vote协议。
815: 4. CP只在AP双方确认后进入low-voltage，寄存器确认恢复480 MHz/bus后再唤醒AP。
816: 5. 完成expired timer处理、heartbeat宽限和Mailbox恢复。
817: 
818: 退出条件：10000次低压进出、短/长timer deadline、RTC/GPIO wakeup、双核负载与故障
819: 注入全部通过；sleep/watchdog不晚触发，monotonic time不倒退。
820:

886: ## 12. 实板验证矩阵
887: 
888: | 测试 | 方法 | 通过标准 |
889: | --- | --- | --- |
890: | 480 MHz契约 | CP读取全部vote、source、core/bus divider、三个CPU speed、VDDD/VDDDIG | slot/cache/寄存器一致；CPU0=240、AP=480、bus实测240；无320M clamp |
891: | wall clock | 对比外部计时60秒/1小时 | 无2倍或1/2倍走时 |
892: | heartbeat | 记录1000个间隔 | 约2秒，发送失败有统计，无CP timeout |
893: | 旧回卷边界 | debug seed + 3小时静置 | sleep继续唤醒，无时间倒退和assert |
894: | CPU ID | affinity任务读取 `sched_getcpu()` | 分别稳定为0、1 |
895: | CPU2启动 | 100次冷启动 | 全部500 ms内online |
896: | 双向IPI | CPU0->CPU1和CPU1->CPU0 | callback CPU和次数正确，无lost kick |
897: | task migration | mask 0x3计算任务 | 可迁移且状态完整 |
898: | atomic | 两核各加100万次 | 精确200万 |
899: | DMA+atomic | DMA写普通SRAM并发lock压力 | 无silent DMA write loss |
900: | interrupt stack | 中断嵌套和stack coloration | 两核MSP不重叠、不越界 |
901: | PSRAM | owner/error/电压故障注入及两核并发alloc/free | init失败不置bit/ready；CP owner不被AP OFF误关；VDDDIG不低于0.95 V；generation和计数一致 |
902: | Mailbox | log、PWC、Wi-Fi与IPI并发 | 无ACK覆盖、FIFO死锁、heartbeat丢失 |
903: | 外设owner | GPIO/PWM/I2C/camera/Wi-Fi回归 | IRQ只在logical CPU0，行为与单核一致 |
904: | P0 idle | 两核空闲WFI | 可由SysTick/IPI/Mailbox唤醒，CP不进LV |
905: | P1低压 | 短/长timer deadline及RTC/GPIO唤醒循环 | deadline唤醒不丢失，时间不倒退，480 MHz/bus恢复后再运行AP |
906: | shutdown | 请求AP recovery | park/reset CPU2、释放AP PSRAM owner、关CPU2、关CPU1、最后释放频率slot |
907: 
908: 故障注入：
909: 
910: - CPU2保持reset、secondary vector错位、CPU2 IRQ route屏蔽。
911: - channel 2 FIFO full、丢kick、重复kick、pending bit竞态。
912: - CP拒绝480 MHz、强制320 MHz clamp、readback不一致。
913: - bus divider写失败、切频helper返回错误、PSRAM仍ON时请求降到60 MHz。
914: - heartbeat send返回 `-EBUSY`/`-ENOLINK`。
915: - AP在CPU2未park时请求shutdown。
916: - PSRAM OFFLINE/recovery期间CPU2发起分配。
917: - P1阶段只让一个AP核设置WFI bit，确认CP拒绝进入low-voltage。
918: - P1恢复时暂不恢复480 MHz，确认AP不解除PM barrier。
919: 
920: ## 13. 完成定义
921: 
922: 只有同时满足以下条件才算完成：
923: 
924: 1. 最终包仍只有一个AP `app1.bin`，CPU1/CPU2共享同一个NuttX实例。
925: 2. CP在CPU1 reset前建立并验证480 MHz AP档位，运行期不发生未协调DVFS。
926: 3. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，旧的长期静置重启不可复现。
927: 4. CPU2使用独立bootstrap、idle和interrupt stack，private arch状态正确。
928: 5. CPU2启动失败fail-stop，不发送虚假PWC ready。
929: 6. 双向schedule/call IPI无丢失，SMP调度和task migration稳定。
930: 7. AP_SPINLOCK atomic gate通过两核、DMA和外设并发压力。
931: 8. 只有logical CPU0产生系统tick，wall clock和heartbeat周期正确。
932: 9. CP transport和普通外设保持logical CPU0 owner且SMP-safe。
933: 10. CPU2先park/reset，CP依次关闭CPU2/CPU1，最后释放480 MHz slot并重新仲裁VDDDIG。
934: 11. S0-S4完成后通过24小时SMP稳定性测试。
935: 12. P1只有在NuttX SMP PM、AON时间、deadline wake、双核WFI barrier和恢复协议完成后
936:     才标记支持。
937: 
938: ## 14. 实施顺序总结
939: 
940: ```text
941: SYSTEM_TIME64 + CP 480 MHz单一生命周期slot
942:   -> 单核3小时验证
943:   -> SMP配置、AP_SPINLOCK和每核栈
944:   -> CPU2 secondary vector/reset/online
945:   -> channel 2 raw IPI和NuttX SMP hooks
946:   -> driver affinity与共享锁
947:   -> PSRAM/Wi-Fi/camera等功能回归
948:   -> 24小时稳定性
949:   -> AON-backed time和coordinated low-voltage
950: ```
951: 
952: 不要把低压睡眠、runtime DVFS、cacheable PSRAM、CPU2 hotplug和首次SMP启动放进同一
953: 提交。先证明固定480 MHz、64位时间、cache-off、单tick、CPU0外设owner模式下的双核
954: 调度正确，再逐项开放功耗和性能优化。

100: ## 3. 正确构建链条
101: 
102: 最终固件链条固定为：
103: 
104: ```text
105: OpenVela nuttx.bin
106:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
107:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
108:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
109:   -> package/all-app.bin
110: 
111: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
112:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
113: ```
114: 
115: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
116: 
117: - `ram_regions.csv`
118: - AP/CP `config`
119: - Kconfig 默认值
120: - 分区生成脚本
121: - SoC 链接脚本

123: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
124: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
125: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。

135: cp \
136:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
137:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin

257: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
258: 
259: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
260: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
261: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
262: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
263: 
264: ```text
265: ap_console status
266: ap_console open
267: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
268: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
269: ap_console status
270: ```
271: 
272: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
273: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
274: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
275: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
276: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。

105: /* This enumeration provides all power management states.  Receipt of the
106:  * state indication is the state transition event.

108: 
109: enum pm_state_e
110: {
111:   PM_RESTORE = -1, /* PM_RESTORE is not a low power state.
112:                     *
113:                     * PM_RESTORE is used to notify for restore from low power
114:                     * state.
115:                     */
116:   PM_NORMAL = 0,   /* Normal full power operating mode.  If the driver is in
117:                     * a reduced power usage mode, it should immediately re-
118:                     * initialize for normal operatin.
119:                     *
120:                     * PM_NORMAL may be followed by PM_IDLE.
121:                     */
122:   PM_IDLE,         /* Drivers will receive this state change if it is
123:                     * appropriate to enter a simple IDLE power state.  This
124:                     * would include simple things such as reducing display
125:                     * back-lighting.  The driver should be ready to resume
126:                     * normal activity instantly.
127:                     *
128:                     * PM_IDLE may be followed by PM_STANDBY or PM_NORMAL.
129:                     */
130:   PM_STANDBY,      /* The system is entering standby mode. Standby is a lower
131:                     * power consumption mode that may involve more extensive
132:                     * power management steps such has disabling clocking or
133:                     * setting the processor into reduced power consumption
134:                     * modes. In this state, the system should still be able
135:                     * to resume normal activity almost immediately.
136:                     *
137:                     * PM_STANDBY may be followed PM_SLEEP or by PM_NORMAL
138:                     */
139:   PM_SLEEP,        /* The system is entering deep sleep mode.  The most
140:                     * drastic power reduction measures possible should be
141:                     * taken in this state. It may require some time to get
142:                     * back to normal operation from SLEEP (some MCUs may
143:                     * even require going through reset).
144:                     *
145:                     * PM_SLEEP may be following by PM_NORMAL
146:                     */

235:    * Description:
236:    *   Request the driver to prepare for a new power state. This is a

238:    *   driver should begin whatever operations that may be required to enter

251:    *   is prepared for the PM state change.  Non-zero means that the driver
252:    *   is not prepared to perform the tasks needed achieve this power setting
253:    *   and will cause the state change to be aborted.  NOTE:  The prepare
254:    *   method will also be recalled when reverting from lower back to higher
255:    *   power consumption modes (say because another driver refused a lower
256:    *   power state change).  Drivers are not permitted to return non-zero
257:    *   values when reverting back to higher power consumption modes!
258:    *
259:    **************************************************************************/

267:    * Description:

270:    *   state.
271:    *
272:    * Input Parameters:

277:    *   pmstate - Identifies the new PM state
278:    *

281:    *   consumption state when when it returned OK to the prepare() call.

284:    *
285:    **************************************************************************/

58:   struct xcptcontext *xcp = &tcb->xcp;
59: 
60:   /* Initialize the initial exception register context structure */
61: 
62:   memset(xcp, 0, sizeof(struct xcptcontext));
63: 
64:   /* Initialize the idle thread stack */
65: 
66:   if (tcb->pid == IDLE_PROCESS_ID)
67:     {
68:       tcb->stack_alloc_ptr = (void *)(g_idle_topstack -
69:                                       CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE);
70:       tcb->stack_base_ptr  = tcb->stack_alloc_ptr;
71:       tcb->adj_stack_size  = CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE;
72: 
73: #ifdef CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION
74:       /* If stack debug is enabled, then fill the stack with a
75:        * recognizable value that we can use later to test for high
76:        * water marks.
77:        */
78: 
79:       arm_stack_color(tcb->stack_alloc_ptr, 0);
80: #endif /* CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION */
81: 
82:       return;
83:     }
84: 
85:   /* Initialize the context registers to stack top */
86: 
87:   xcp->regs = (void *)((uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
88:                                  tcb->adj_stack_size -
89:                                  XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
90: 
91:   /* Initialize the xcp registers */
92: 
93:   memset(xcp->regs, 0, XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
94: 
95:   /* Save the initial stack pointer */
96: 
97:   xcp->regs[REG_SP]      = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
98:                                      tcb->adj_stack_size;
99: 
100: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK
101:   /* Set the stack limit value */
102: 
103:   xcp->regs[REG_R10]     = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_alloc_ptr + 64;
104: #endif
105: 
106: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
107:   /* Save the stack limit value, will be used in context switch. */
108: 
109:   xcp->regs[REG_SPLIM]   = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_alloc_ptr;
110: #endif
111: 
112:   /* Save the task entry point (stripping off the thumb bit) */
113: 
114:   xcp->regs[REG_PC]      = (uint32_t)tcb->start & ~1;
115: 
116:   /* Specify thumb mode */
117: 
118:   xcp->regs[REG_XPSR]    = ARM_XPSR_T;
119: 
120:   /* All tasks need to set pic address to special register */
121: 
122: #ifdef CONFIG_BUILD_PIC
123:   __asm__ ("mov %0, r9" : "=r"(xcp->regs[REG_R9]));
124: #endif
125: 
126:   /* If this task is running PIC, then set the PIC base register to the
127:    * address of the allocated D-Space region.
128:    */
129: 
130: #ifdef CONFIG_PIC
131:   if (tcb->dspace != NULL)
132:     {
133:       /* Set the PIC base register (probably R10) to the address of the
134:        * alloacated D-Space region.
135:        */
136: 
137:       xcp->regs[REG_PIC] = (uint32_t)tcb->dspace->region;
138:     }
139: 
140: #ifdef CONFIG_NXFLAT
141:   /* Make certain that bit 0 is set in the main entry address.  This
142:    * is only an issue when NXFLAT is enabled.  NXFLAT doesn't know
143:    * anything about thumb; the addresses that NXFLAT sets are based
144:    * on file header info and won't have bit 0 set.
145:    */
146: 
147:   tcb->entry.main = (main_t)((uint32_t)tcb->entry.main | 1);
148: #endif
149: #endif /* CONFIG_PIC */
150: 
151:   /* All tasks start via a stub function in kernel space.  So all
152:    * tasks must start in privileged thread mode.  If CONFIG_BUILD_PROTECTED
153:    * is defined, then that stub function will switch to unprivileged
154:    * mode before transferring control to the user task.
155:    */
156: 
157:   xcp->regs[REG_EXC_RETURN] = EXC_RETURN_THREAD;
158: 
159:   xcp->regs[REG_CONTROL] = getcontrol() & ~CONTROL_NPRIV;
160: 
161: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_FPU
162:   xcp->regs[REG_FPSCR]  |= ARM_FPSCR_LTPSIZE_NONE;
163: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_FPU */
164: 
165:   /* Enable or disable interrupts, based on user configuration */
166: 
167: #ifdef CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS
168: 
169:   xcp->regs[REG_BASEPRI] = NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY;
170: 
171: #else /* CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS */
172: 
173:   xcp->regs[REG_BASEPRI] = 0;
174: 
175: #endif /* CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS */
176: 
177: #if defined(CONFIG_BUILD_FLAT) && defined(CONFIG_ARCH_ADDRENV)
178:   xcp->nkernels = 1;
179: #endif
180: }

438: 		hardware abstraction and management of symmetric multiprocessing.

441: 		can run on. You can use both SMP and BMP on the same system, allowing

455: 		system by allowing applications that share the same data set to run

458: 		threads within an application run on a single CPU.

55:  *   (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).  Having a start-up function such as this for the
56:  *   IDLE is not really an architectural necessity.  It is used only for
57:  *   symmetry with how other threads are started (see nxtask_start() and
58:  *   pthread_start()).
59:  *
60:  * Input Parameters:
61:  *   None.
62:  *
63:  * Returned Value:
64:  *   This function does not return.
65:  *
66:  ****************************************************************************/
67: 
68: void nx_idle_trampoline(void)
69: {
70: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION_SWITCH
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();
72: 
73:   /* Announce that the IDLE task has started */
74: 
75:   sched_note_start(tcb);
76: #endif
77: 
78:   /* wait until cpu0 in idle() */
79: 
80:   while (!OSINIT_IDLELOOP());
81: 
82:   sched_unlock();
83: 
84:   /* Enter the IDLE loop */
85: 
86:   sinfo("CPU%d: Beginning Idle Loop\n", this_cpu());
87: 
88:   for (; ; )
89:     {
90:       /* Perform any processor-specific idle state operations */
91: 
92:       up_idle();
93:     }
94: }

96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)

131:       /* Start the CPU */
132: 
133:       ret = up_cpu_start(cpu);
134:       if (ret < 0)
135:         {
136:           serr("ERROR: Failed to start CPU%d: %d\n", cpu, ret);
137:           return ret;
138:         }
139:     }
140: 
141:   return OK;

79:  * Description:
80:  *   Drain all data in the inter-processor FIFO
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static void fifo_drain(void)
84: {
85:   putreg32(0, RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST);
86: 
87:   while (getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_VLD)
88:     {
89:       getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_RD);
90:     }

92:   __asm__ volatile ("sev");

95: /****************************************************************************
96:  * Name: fifo_comm
97:  *
98:  * Description:
99:  *   Communicate with CPU Core 1 using inter-processor FIFO for boot
100:  *
101:  * Input Parameters:
102:  *   msg - Data to be sent to Core 1
103:  *
104:  * Returned Value:
105:  *   true on success; false on failure.
106:  *
107:  ****************************************************************************/
108: 
109: static int fifo_comm(uint32_t msg)
110: {
111:   uint32_t rcv;
112: 
113:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_RDY))
114:     ;
115:   putreg32(msg, RP2040_SIO_FIFO_WR);
116:   __asm__ volatile ("sev");
117: 
118:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST) & RP2040_SIO_FIFO_ST_VLD))
119:     __asm__ volatile ("wfe");
120: 
121:   rcv = getreg32(RP2040_SIO_FIFO_RD);
122: 
123:   return msg == rcv;
124: }

174: /****************************************************************************
175:  * Name: up_cpu_start
176:  *
177:  * Description:
178:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
179:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
180:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
181:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
182:  *
183:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
184:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
185:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
186:  *   initialized.
187:  *
188:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
189:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
190:  *
191:  * Input Parameters:
192:  *   cpu - The index of the CPU being started.  This will be a numeric
193:  *         value in the range of one to (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
194:  *         (CPU 0 is already active)
195:  *
196:  * Returned Value:
197:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
198:  *
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
202: {
203:   int i;
204:   struct tcb_s *tcb = current_task(cpu);
205:   uint32_t core1_boot_msg[5];
206: 
207:   DPRINTF("cpu=%d\n", cpu);
208: 
209: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
210:   /* Notify of the start event */
211: 
212:   sched_note_cpu_start(this_task(), cpu);
213: #endif
214: 
215:   /* Reset Core 1 */
216: 
217:   setbits_reg32(RP2040_PSM_PROC1, RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF);
218:   while (!(getreg32(RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF) & RP2040_PSM_PROC1))
219:     ;
220:   clrbits_reg32(RP2040_PSM_PROC1, RP2040_PSM_FRCE_OFF);
221: 
222:   spin_lock(&g_core1_boot);
223: 
224:   /* Send initial VTOR, MSP, PC for Core 1 boot */
225: 
226:   core1_boot_msg[0] = 0;
227:   core1_boot_msg[1] = 1;
228:   core1_boot_msg[2] = getreg32(ARMV6M_SYSCON_VECTAB);
229:   core1_boot_msg[3] = (uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
230:                                 tcb->adj_stack_size;
231:   core1_boot_msg[4] = (uint32_t)core1_boot;
232: 
233:   do
234:     {
235:       fifo_drain();
236:       for (i = 0; i < 5; i++)
237:         {
238:           if (!fifo_comm(core1_boot_msg[i]))
239:             {
240:               break;
241:             }
242:         }
243:     }
244:   while (i < 5);
245: 
246:   fifo_drain();
247: 
248:   /* Enable inter-processor FIFO interrupt */
249: 
250:   irq_attach(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC0, rp2040_smp_call_handler, NULL);
251:   up_enable_irq(RP2040_SMP_CALL_PROC0);
252: 
253:   spin_lock(&g_core1_boot);
254: 
255:   /* CPU Core 1 boot done */
256: 
257:   spin_unlock(&g_core1_boot);
258: 
259:   return 0;
260: }
261: 
262: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

41:  * Name: up_cpu_idlestack
42:  *
43:  * Description:
44:  *   Allocate a stack for the CPU[n] IDLE task (n > 0) if appropriate and
45:  *   setup up stack-related information in the IDLE task's TCB.  This
46:  *   function is always called before up_cpu_start().  This function is
47:  *   only called for the CPU's initial IDLE task; up_create_task is used for
48:  *   all normal tasks, pthreads, and kernel threads for all CPUs.
49:  *
50:  *   The initial IDLE task is a special case because the CPUs can be started
51:  *   in different wans in different environments:
52:  *
53:  *   1. The CPU may already have been started and waiting in a low power
54:  *      state for up_cpu_start().  In this case, the IDLE thread's stack
55:  *      has already been allocated and is already in use.  Here
56:  *      up_cpu_idlestack() only has to provide information about the
57:  *      already allocated stack.
58:  *
59:  *   2. The CPU may be disabled but started when up_cpu_start() is called.
60:  *      In this case, a new stack will need to be created for the IDLE
61:  *      thread and this function is then equivalent to:
62:  *
63:  *      return up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
64:  *
65:  *   The following TCB fields must be initialized by this function:
66:  *
67:  *   - adj_stack_size: Stack size after adjustment for hardware, processor,
68:  *     etc.  This value is retained only for debug purposes.
69:  *   - stack_alloc_ptr: Pointer to allocated stack
70:  *   - stack_base_ptr: Adjusted stack base pointer after the TLS Data and
71:  *     Arguments has been removed from the stack allocation.
72:  *
73:  * Input Parameters:
74:  *   - cpu:         CPU index that indicates which CPU the IDLE task is
75:  *                  being created for.
76:  *   - tcb:         The TCB of new CPU IDLE task
77:  *   - stack_size:  The requested stack size for the IDLE task.  At least
78:  *                  this much must be allocated.  This should be
79:  *                  CONFIG_SMP_STACK_SIZE.
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: int up_cpu_idlestack(int cpu, struct tcb_s *tcb, size_t stack_size)
84: {
85: #if CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS > 1
86:   up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
87: #endif
88:   return OK;
89: }

10: 
11: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
12: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
13:

17: #include "nvic.h"

21: #define DEFPRIORITY32 \
22:   (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 24 | \
23:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 16 | \
24:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \
25:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
26: 
27: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
28: {
29:   uintptr_t regaddr;
30:   uint32_t bit;
31: 
32:   if (extirq < 32)
33:     {
34:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0;
35:       bit = 1u << extirq;
36:     }
37:   else
38:     {
39:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1;
40:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
41:     }
42: 
43:   if (enable)
44:     {
45:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
50:     }
51: }
52: 
53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)
55: {
56:   int extirq;
57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
59: 
60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {
62:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
85:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
86:         break;
87:       default:
88:         return ERROR;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return OK;
92: }
93: 
94: static inline void bk7258_prioritize_svcall(int priority)
95: {
96:   uint32_t regval = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
97:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
98:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;
99:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
100: }
101: 
102: void up_irqinitialize(void)
103: {
104:   uintptr_t regaddr;
105:   int priority_registers;
106:   int i;
107: 
108:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
109:     {
110:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
111:     }
112: 
113:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);
114:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1);
115: 
116:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
117:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
118:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
119: 
120:   priority_registers = ((getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) & 0x1f) + 1) * 8;
121:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
122:   while (priority_registers-- > 0)
123:     {
124:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
125:       regaddr += 4;
126:     }
127: 
128:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
129:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
130:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
131:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
132:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
133:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
134:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
135:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
136: 
137:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
138:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
139:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);
140:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT);
141:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT);
142:   up_irq_enable();
143: }
144: 
145: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
146: {
147:   uintptr_t regaddr;
148:   uint32_t regval;
149:   uint32_t bit;
150: 
151:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, 0) == OK)
152:     {
153:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
154:         {
155:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, true);
156:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
157:         }
158:       else
159:         {
160:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
161:           putreg32(regval | bit, regaddr);
162:         }
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
167: {
168:   uintptr_t regaddr;
169:   uint32_t regval;
170:   uint32_t bit;
171: 
172:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit,
173:                      NVIC_IRQ0_31_CLEAR - NVIC_IRQ0_31_ENABLE) == OK)
174:     {
175:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
176:         {
177:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
178:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, false);
179:         }
180:       else
181:         {
182:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
183:           putreg32(regval & ~bit, regaddr);
184:         }
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: void arm_ack_irq(int irq)
189: {
190: }
191: 
192: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
193: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
194: {
195:   uintptr_t regaddr;
196:   uint32_t regval;
197:   int shift;
198: 
199:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS);
200:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned int)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
201: 
202:   if (irq < BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
203:     {
204:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
205:       irq -= 4;
206:     }
207:   else
208:     {
209:       irq -= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
210:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
211:     }
212: 
213:   shift = (irq & 3) << 3;
214:   regval = getreg32(regaddr);
215:   regval &= ~(0xffu << shift);
216:   regval |= (uint32_t)priority << shift;
217:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);
218:   return OK;
219: }
220: #endif

2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/

6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_REG(n)             (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
21: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG            MBOX_REG(0x20)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG       MBOX_REG(0x21)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x22)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x23)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_TID            MBOX_REG(0x24)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_SID            MBOX_REG(0x25)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x26)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x27)
29: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x28)
30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CH2_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x38)
32: #define MBOX_CTRL               MBOX_REG(2)
33: 
34: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
41: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
43:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
44: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
45: 
46: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
47: 
48: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
51:   uint32_t order;
52:   bool used;
53: };
54: 
55: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
56: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
57: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
58: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
59: static bool g_mbox_ready;
60: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
61: 
62: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
63:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
64: 
65: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
66: {
67:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
68: }
69: 
70: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
71: {
72:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
73:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.write_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.read_error++;
83:     }
84: 
85:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
86:     {
87:       g_stats.write_full++;
88:     }
89: 
90:   if (errors != 0)
91:     {
92:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
93:     }
94: }
95: 
96: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
97:                                 uint32_t length)
98: {
99:   if (source != 0)
100:     {
101:       g_stats.bad_source++;
102:       return false;
103:     }
104: 
105:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
106:     {
107:       g_stats.bad_length++;
108:       return false;
109:     }
110: 
111:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
112:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
113:     {
114:       g_stats.bad_address++;
115:       return false;
116:     }
117: 
118:   return true;
119: }
120: 
121: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
122: {
123:   uintptr_t status;
124: 
125:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
126:     {
127:       return -EINVAL;
128:     }
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
142:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
143:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
144:   return OK;
145: }
146: 
147: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
148: {
149:   unsigned int i;
150: 
151:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
152:     {
153:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
154:         {
155:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:   return NULL;
160: }
161: 
162: static bool mbox_priority_message(
163:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
164: {
165:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
166: 
167:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
168: }
169: 
170: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
171: {
172:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
178: 
179:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
180:         {
181:           continue;
182:         }
183: 
184:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
185:         {
186:           oldest = desc;
187:         }
188:     }
189: 
190:   return oldest;
191: }
192: 
193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }
229: 
230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
257:         {
258:           continue;
259:         }
260: 
261:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
262:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
263:              sizeof(desc->message));
264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
267:       mbox_process_desc();
268:     }
269: 
270:   mbox_process_desc();
271: 
272:   return OK;
273: }
274: 
275: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
276: {
277:   g_callback = callback;
278: }
279: 
280: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
281: {
282:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
283: 
284:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
285:   up_irq_restore(flags);
286: }
287: 
288: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
289: {
290:   unsigned int i;
291: 
292:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
293:     {
294:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
295:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
296:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
297:         {
298:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
299:         }
300:     }
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
304: {
305:   irqstate_t flags;
306: 
307:   if (stats == NULL)
308:     {
309:       return;
310:     }
311: 
312:   flags = up_irq_save();
313:   *stats = g_stats;
314:   up_irq_restore(flags);
315: }
316: 
317: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   if (g_mbox_ready)
322:     {
323:       return OK;
324:     }
325: 
326:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
327:   g_rx_order = 0;
328:   g_processing_order = 0;
329:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
330: 
331:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
332:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
333:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
334:    */
335: 
336:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
337:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
338:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
339:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
340:   mbox_clear_errors();
341: 
342:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       return ret;
346:     }
347: 
348:   g_mbox_ready = true;
349:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
350:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
351:   return OK;
352: }

280: /****************************************************************************
281:  * Name: pm_changestate
282:  *
283:  * Description:
284:  *   This function is used by platform-specific power management logic.  It
285:  *   will announce the power management power management state change to all
286:  *   drivers that have registered for power management event callbacks.
287:  *
288:  * Input Parameters:
289:  *   domain   - Identifies the domain of the new PM state
290:  *   newstate - Identifies the new PM state
291:  *
292:  * Returned Value:
293:  *   0 (OK) means that the callback function for all registered drivers
294:  *   returned OK (meaning that they accept the state change).  Non-zero
295:  *   means that one of the drivers refused the state change.  In this case,
296:  *   the system will revert to the preceding state.
297:  *
298:  * Assumptions:
299:  *   It is assumed that interrupts are disabled when this function is
300:  *   called.  This function is probably called from the IDLE loop... the
301:  *   lowest priority task in the system.  Changing driver power management
302:  *   states may result in renewed system activity and, as a result, can
303:  *   suspend the IDLE thread before it completes the entire state change
304:  *   unless interrupts are disabled throughout the state change.
305:  *
306:  ****************************************************************************/
307: 
308: int pm_changestate(int domain, enum pm_state_e newstate)
309: {
310:   FAR struct pm_domain_s *pdom;
311:   irqstate_t flags;
312:   int ret = OK;
313: 
314:   DEBUGASSERT(domain >= 0 && domain < CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS);
315:   pdom = &g_pmdomains[domain];
316: 
317:   /* Disable interrupts throughout this operation... changing driver states
318:    * could cause additional driver activity that might interfere with the
319:    * state change.  When the state change is complete, interrupts will be
320:    * re-enabled.
321:    */
322: 
323:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&pdom->lock);
324: 
325:   if (newstate != PM_RESTORE)
326:     {
327:       /* First, prepare the drivers for the state change.  In this phase,
328:        * drivers may refuse the state state change.
329:        */
330: 
331:       ret = pm_prepall(domain, newstate, false);
332:       if (ret != OK)
333:         {
334:           /* One or more drivers is not ready for this state change.
335:            * Revert to the preceding state.
336:            */
337: 
338:           newstate = g_pmdomains[domain].state;
339:           pm_prepall(domain, newstate, true);
340:         }
341:     }
342: 
343:   /* Statistics */
344: 
345:   pm_stats(&g_pmdomains[domain],
346:            g_pmdomains[domain].state, newstate);
347: 
348:   /* All drivers have agreed to the state change (or, one or more have
349:    * disagreed and the state has been reverted).  Set the new state.
350:    */
351: 
352:   pm_changeall(domain, newstate);
353: 
354:   /* Notify governor of (possible) state change */
355: 
356:   if (g_pmdomains[domain].governor->statechanged)
357:     {
358:       g_pmdomains[domain].governor->statechanged(domain, newstate);
359:     }
360: 
361:   /* Domain state update after statechanged done */
362: 
363:   if (newstate != PM_RESTORE)
364:     {
365:       g_pmdomains[domain].state = newstate;
366:     }
367: 
368:   /* Restore the interrupt state */
369: 
370:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&pdom->lock, flags);
371:   return ret;
372: }

42: /****************************************************************************
43:  * Name: pm_register_callback
44:  *
45:  * Description:
46:  *   This function register callback in order of priority to target domain.
47:  *
48:  * Input Parameters:
49:  *   pdom - Target register domain.
50:  *   cb   - An instance of struct pm_callback_s providing the driver
51:  *            callback functions.
52:  *
53:  * Returned Value:
54:  *   Zero (OK) on success; otherwise a negated errno value is returned.
55:  *
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: static int pm_register_callback(FAR struct pm_domain_s *pdom,
59:                                 FAR struct pm_callback_s *cb)
60: {
61:   dq_queue_t *head = &pdom->registry;
62:   dq_entry_t *node;
63: 
64:   for (node = head->tail; node; node = node->flink)
65:     {
66:       struct pm_callback_s *ncb;
67: 
68:       ncb = container_of(node, struct pm_callback_s, entry);
69:       if (ncb == cb)
70:         {
71:           return -EEXIST;
72:         }
73: 
74:       /* Callbacks with higher prio should be in front of registry dqlist
75:        * so that they are called first.
76:        */
77: 
78:       if (cb->prio <= ncb->prio)
79:         {
80:           dq_addafter(node, &cb->entry, head);
81:           return OK;
82:         }
83:     }
84: 
85:   dq_addfirst(&cb->entry, head);
86:   return OK;
87: }

48: /****************************************************************************

50:  *
51:  * Description:
52:  *   This function creates and activates a new thread of the specified type
53:  *   with a specified priority and returns its system-assigned ID.  It is the
54:  *   internal, common implementation of task_create() and kthread_create().
55:  *   See comments with task_create() for further information.
56:  *
57:  * Input Parameters:
58:  *   name       - Name of the new task
59:  *   ttype      - Type of the new task
60:  *   priority   - Priority of the new task
61:  *   stack_addr - Address of the stack needed
62:  *   stack_size - Size (in bytes) of the stack needed
63:  *   entry      - Entry point of a new task
64:  *   arg        - A pointer to an array of input parameters.  The array
65:  *                should be terminated with a NULL argv[] value. If no
66:  *                parameters are required, argv may be NULL.
67:  *   envp       - A pointer to an array of environment strings. Terminated
68:  *                with a NULL entry.
69:  *
70:  * Returned Value:
71:  *   Returns the positive, non-zero process ID of the new task or a negated
72:  *   errno value to indicate the nature of any failure.  If memory is
73:  *   insufficient or the task cannot be created -ENOMEM will be returned.
74:  *
75:  ****************************************************************************/

77: int nxthread_create(FAR const char *name, int ttype, int priority,
78:                     FAR void *stack_addr, int stack_size, main_t entry,
79:                     FAR char * const argv[], FAR char * const envp[])
80: {
81:   posix_spawnattr_t attr;
82:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb;
83:   pid_t pid;
84:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
85: 
86:   posix_spawnattr_init(&attr);
87:   posix_spawnattr_setstacksize(&attr, (size_t)stack_size);
88:   posix_spawnattr_setstackaddr(&attr, stack_addr);
89:   posix_spawnattr_setpriority(&attr, priority);
90: 
91:   /* Allocate a TCB for the new task. */
92: 
93:   tcb = kmm_zalloc(ttype == TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL ?
94:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) :
95:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) + sizeof(struct task_group_s));
96:   if (!tcb)
97:     {
98:       serr("ERROR: Failed to allocate TCB\n");
99:     }
100:   else
101:     {
102:       /* Setup the task type */
103: 
104:       atomic_set(&tcb->flags, ttype | TCB_FLAG_FREE_TCB);
105: 
106:       /* Initialize the task */
107: 
108:       ret = nxtask_init(tcb, name, entry, NULL, &attr, argv, envp);
109:       posix_spawnattr_destroy(&attr);
110:       if (ret < OK)
111:         {
112:           kmm_free(tcb);
113:         }
114:       else
115:         {
116:           /* Get the assigned pid before we start the task */
117: 
118:           pid = tcb->pid;
119: 
120:           /* Activate the task */
121: 
122:           nxtask_activate(tcb);
123: 
124:           ret = pid;
125:         }
126:     }
127: 
128:   return ret;
129: }

86: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
87: {
88:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
89:   struct pwc_message message;
90:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
91:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
92:     {
93:       return;
94:     }
95:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
102: }

104: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
105: {
106:   (void)argc;
107:   (void)argv;
108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }

   **计划第 720 行：**“`kthread_create() 后立即 sched_setaffinity(mask=0x1)；失败则该driver bring-up失败。`”  
   **证据：**`sched_setaffinity()` 必须接收 `pid, cpusetsize, cpu_set_t *` 三个参数；并且 `kthread_create()` 在返回 PID 前已经执行 `nxtask_activate()`，所以事后 pin 不能保证 worker 在 pin 前没有运行：[sched.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/sched.h:253)、[task_create.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/task/task_create.c:120)、[task_create.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/task/task_create.c:293)。  
   **替换为：**“`worker入口在访问任何driver状态前执行CPU_ZERO/CPU_SET(0)及sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)，成功后才通知creator ready；creator等待该ready，失败则driver bring-up失败。`”
